values.value: Use when a provider reports a patient adverse event, unexpected reaction, or treatment complication following an Allergan Moxie product administration. This is a compliance-sensitive communication — all mandatory reporting steps must be preserved exactly.

Dear [Contact.FirstName],
Thank you for contacting Allergan Moxie Provider Services regarding Case #[Case.CaseNumber]. We take all reports of adverse events seriously and appreciate your prompt communication.
To process this report in compliance with Allergan Moxie safety reporting requirements, please provide the following as soon as possible:
1. Completed Adverse Event Reporting Form (Form AM-AE-003) — this must be submitted within 72 hours of the event occurring or being identified. 2. The product lot number(s) and expiry date(s) of all Allergan Moxie products administered during the treatment session. 3. A brief clinical description of the event including onset timing, severity, and any treatment or intervention provided to the patient. 4. Patient consent confirmation — please retain a copy of the signed Form AM-PC-005 in the patient file; you do not need to submit it, but it must be available for review if requested.
Please note: failure to report a confirmed adverse event within 72 hours may affect your account standing under the Allergan Moxie Provider Agreement (Section 4.2 — Safety Reporting Obligations).
Our clinical support team will follow up with you within one business day of receiving the completed Form AM-AE-003.
Warm regards, [User.FirstName] [User.LastName] Provider Services Representative Allergan Moxie
